title: Wings Combat
description: A Brand new all in one combate plugin.
body:
# 🛡️ WingsCombat - Professional Combat Tagging System

**WingsCombat** is a lightweight, high-performance combat-tagging plugin designed to ensure fair PvP on your Minecraft server. It prevents players from escaping combat by logging out, running into protected regions, or performing unauthorized actions.

### ✨ Key Features

* **Anti-Combat Log:** Automatically kills players who attempt to log out while in combat (configurable).
* **Region Integration:** Seamlessly works with **WorldGuard** and **GriefPrevention**. If a player is in combat, they are blocked from entering protected areas/claims.
* **Visual Feedback:** Displays a temporary "Red Glass" wall at the border of protected regions when a player tries to enter while tagged.
* **Action Bar Timer:** Keeps players informed with a live countdown in their Action Bar.
* **PvP Control:** Options to disable item dropping, chat, and commands while a player is in combat to prevent "ghosting" or unfair advantages.
* **Highly Configurable:** Customize everything—from combat duration and death messages to granular feature toggles—all via the `config.yml`.
* **Lightweight:** Built to be efficient and lag-free, even on busy servers.

### 📋 Configuration & Customization

You have full control over the player experience. Easily modify these settings:

* **Combat Time:** Set the duration (in seconds) that the combat tag lasts.
* **Kill on Quit:** Toggle whether players die instantly upon disconnecting during a fight.
* **Death Settings:** Decide whether players should drop items or keep them upon death while tagged.
* **Message Customization:** Every message (prefix, combat warnings, denial messages) supports color codes and can be translated to any language.

### ⚙️ Commands & Permissions

* `/wc reload` — Reloads the plugin configuration.
* **Permission:** `wingscombat.admin`



### 🛠️ Installation

1. Drop `WingsCombat.jar` into your server's `/plugins` folder.
2. Start or restart your server to generate the default configuration.
3. Edit the `config.yml` to match your server's needs.
4. Run `/wc reload` to apply your changes.

### 🧩 Optional Dependencies

For the best experience, WingsCombat integrates with:

* [WorldGuard](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/worldguard)
* [GriefPrevention](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/griefprevention.1884/)

---

*Keep your PvP fair, prevent combat logging, and maintain order on your server with **WingsCombat**!*
